budget_items.topic: Chapter 70 aid at risk if end-of-year report is late
budget_items.what_was_recorded: If the DESE report is not submitted by the deadline, monthly Chapter 70 funds may not be received; the file was submitted incomplete to avoid this.
budget_items.quote: there is a possibility, we will not receive our monthly chapter 70 funds

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Resignations of ESSER-funded positions created a surplus; a Guidance Counselor position is being advertised.
budget_items.quote: resignations of positions in esser has created a surplus

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Reconciling petty cash accounts requires taking money from the budget line; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: we need to take money from our budget line to reconcile the accounts

budget_items.topic: Student activity class accounts with pending money
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Some class activity accounts have been open for over 10 years holding pending money; the funds could defray field trip costs or fund scholarships. No amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: some of these accounts have been left open for upwards of 10 years and have pending money in them

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An increase in athletic fees may be considered in the next two years; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: we could be looking at an increase in athletic fees in the next two years.

budget_items.topic: FY25 budget: expected increase to regular expenses
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Regular expenses are expected to rise by about $1 million in the next budget year.
budget_items.quote: we are expecting a $1 million increase to our regular expenses in this next budget year.

budget_items.topic: FY25 budget: health insurance and total expenditure increase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Health insurance is expected to rise 10%, with a total increase in expenditures of $7,672,125.
budget_items.quote: health insurance is expected to increase 10%, total increase in expenditures of $7,672,125.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A loss of ESSER funds of $650,000 was reported, described as much more significant than expected.
budget_items.quote: we have a loss of $650,000 in esser funds, this is much more significant than we expected.

budget_items.topic: FY25 budget: anticipated increase versus insurance
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The anticipated 2.5% budget increase was described as barely covering insurance; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: increase to our budget will barely cover our insurance.
